userStories.title: Create ExerciseLog model
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy model for storing exercise/workout data from Cronometer. Fields: id (UUID), user_id (FK to users), logged_at (datetime indexed), name (String 200), duration_minutes (Float), calories_burned (Float), raw_data (JSONB), cronometer_hash (unique indexed), created_at. Add relationship to User model.
acceptanceCriteria: Foreign key to users table with CASCADE delete
logged_at is indexed for date range queries
cronometer_hash is unique and indexed for deduplication

userStories.title: Create Alembic migration for exercise_logs table
userStories.description: Generate Alembic migration for the exercise_logs table with proper indexes and constraints.
acceptanceCriteria: Alembic migration file created in backend/alembic/versions/
Migration creates exercise_logs table with all columns
Indexes on user_id, logged_at, and cronometer_hash
Foreign key constraint to users table with CASCADE delete

userStories.title: Create Conversation and Message models
userStories.description: Create SQLAlchemy models for chat conversations and messages. Conversation has: id, user_id, title (nullable), created_at, updated_at. Message has: id, conversation_id, role (enum: user/assistant/system/tool), content (Text), tool_calls (JSONB nullable), tool_call_id (String nullable), tokens_used (Integer nullable), created_at. Add relationships to User model.
acceptanceCriteria: MessageRole enum defined (user, assistant, system, tool)
Conversation has one-to-many relationship with Messages (cascade delete)
User has one-to-many relationship with Conversations

userStories.title: Create Alembic migration for chat tables
userStories.description: Generate Alembic migration for conversations and messages tables with the MessageRole enum type.
acceptanceCriteria: Alembic migration file created in backend/alembic/versions/
Migration creates messages table with JSONB tool_calls column
MessageRole enum type created in PostgreSQL
Proper foreign key constraints and indexes
